meta.title: HomeForAll · From rescue to forever home
meta.description: A verified network connecting rescue groups, vet clinics, volunteers, foster homes and adopters of dogs and cats in Ho Chi Minh City.

footer.pilot: Pilot in Diên Hồng ward, Phú Mỹ ward and Thủ Đức, Ho Chi Minh City, from 16 November 2026.
footer.nonprofit: A nonprofit project. HomeForAll will never ask you to pay a deposit to adopt.
footer.prototypeNotice: HomeForAll is an academic project (SDG 15 & 17). Some animal profiles, map points, contact details and partner content are sample data or proposals, with no agreement in place.

why.title: Why HomeForAll
why.body: Rescue, fostering and adoption of dogs and cats in Ho Chi Minh City are scattered across Facebook and Zalo posts: it is hard to know who to trust or whether an animal is still waiting. HomeForAll brings verified partners together so every animal can make the whole journey from rescue to a forever home.

art.title: About the illustrations
art.body: The clay scenes on this site (the neighbourhood, the clinic, Miu the cat and the dog) were created with an AI tool (Google's Gemini video model). They are illustrations, not photographs.
art.mascots: Miu and the dog are the project's characters, not animals waiting for adoption. Photos of animals waiting for a home are always real photos supplied by the rescue partner, with consent.

about.review: The content of this page is awaiting review by the project team.

what: An animal stays with you while it waits for a new family, from a few days to a few months.
The rescue partner explains up front what the animal needs, who covers vet costs and how long it lasts.
You can decline a proposal at any time. HomeForAll never charges you.
steps: A partner proposes an animal that fits your situation.
Accept or decline in one tap.
Get a care checklist and a list of what the animal needs.
You get a reminder near the end; if you like, you can adopt.

proposedPartners.title: Proposed partners
proposedPartners.verifiedEmpty: No partners have been verified yet. The list will be published when the pilot starts.

cocoon.about: Cocoon is a Vietnamese vegan cosmetics brand, on the market since 2013, using local ingredients such as winter melon, Đắk Lắk coffee, Cao Bằng rose and Hậu Giang lotus; its products are not tested on animals. From 2023 to 2025 the brand ran a stray dog and cat rescue programme with Animals Asia Foundation.
cocoon.proposal: co-run communication on responsible adoption and support sterilisation and vaccination costs for rescued animals.

farmina-pet-foods.about: Farmina Pet Foods is a family-owned and family-run pet nutrition company founded in 1965, making dry and wet food for dogs and cats (including the N&D and Vet Life lines), present in more than 75 countries. The company says it runs independent research and non-invasive clinical trials.
farmina-pet-foods.proposal: sponsor food for foster families and newly rescued animals.

msd-animal-health.about: MSD Animal Health is the name of Merck Animal Health outside the United States and Canada. The company has more than 130 years of scientific innovation, operates in more than 150 countries and develops medicines, vaccines and technology for animals, including vaccine solutions for pets.
msd-animal-health.proposal: support educational material on vaccination (especially rabies) for owners and partner clinics.
